response.sql: WITH cat AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description AS d, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, AVG(ABS(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost)) AS avg_diff FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS mean_diff FROM cat) SELECT AVG(cat.avg_qty) AS avg_of_avg_quantity, AVG(cat.avg_diff) AS avg_of_avg_cost_diff, AVG(cat.avg_diff - m.mean_diff) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM cat CROSS JOIN m WHERE cat.avg_diff > m.mean_diff

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is stored as text but holds numeric values, so it is cast to REAL before averaging.
Categories are grouped by product_type_description, as the request says. The mean of category averages is an unweighted mean across all categories that have a non-null average cost difference.
Categories whose lines all have a null cost or total are never above the mean, so they drop out of the final filter.
